title: Mickey Mania (Genesis) - The Prince and the Pauper (Dungeon Section)
description:
Again, this was originally ripped by Edward D-tech and organized by Walmaker. I converted to SMW usage and used palette 1 without affecting the status bar.

While the palette in the second screenshot was used in the castle section, the palette from the first screenshot is a mystery.

I checked The Cutting Room Floor for the prototype and nothing was there.

The palette was either made by them or it was from an unknown source.

Anyway, crediting the two authors would be good.

I don't require being credited.

Enjoy!
